bug.title: The fidelity accounting counts unfilled cancelled orders as rejects, folds time-to-cancel into fill latency, and measures rounding drift against the position target instead of the order quantity
bug.symptoms: (A) router.fidelity classifies every leg without a fill as leg_state "reject" (~line 490). A PostOnly LIMIT order the venue accepted, which then rested unfilled until step 2 of the next slot cancelled it, is counted as a reject. The SOL-USDT SELL leg of slot 2026-10-07T08:00 (place_to_fill_ms 14,390,000) inflates reject_rate to 0.333. Venue rejects and refused placements are a different thing. (B) That leg's 14,390,000 ms (time until cancel) is folded into the place_to_fill_ms distribution, giving p95 12,953,300 and p99 14,102,660. Latency must describe fills only. (C) router_order_record.target_quantity records the leg's position target (for example 8.524 SOL), while the order sends only the change from the current position (0.07 SOL). vst_fidelity's rounding_drift_bps therefore compares two different quantities and reports -9877.7 bps.
bug.reproduction_steps: Seed a store with one accepted LIMIT order that is later CANCELED with executedQty 0, one FILLED order, and one MARKET fill, with a position target much larger than the order delta. Run reconcile_fidelity, then vst_fidelity: reject_rate counts the cancelled order, latency includes its rest time, and drift is near -100%.
bug.expected: - A new leg_state "unfilled" covers a leg the venue accepted that ended CANCELED or EXPIRED with zero executed quantity. "reject" is kept for a venue rejection (status REJECTED, or a placement the venue refused) and a leg the router refused before sending. - router_order_fidelity's CHECK constraint gains "unfilled". The live table is migrated in place: rebuild-and-copy inside one transaction, existing rows preserved, and existing "reject" rows whose fill record shows an accepted then CANCELED/EXPIRED zero-fill reclassified to "unfilled". It is idempotent, and a second run changes nothing. - vst_fidelity reports reject_rate over sent legs (venue and router rejects only) and adds unfilled_rate. place_to_fill_ms percentiles are computed over legs with executed_quantity > 0 only, and the time to cancel is reported separately as unfilled_rest_ms. - target_quantity records the order quantity before step/tick rounding: the delta the router sized, not the position target. rounding_drift_bps compares sent quantity with that pre-rounding order quantity, in bps of the order's notional. A record from before this fix (target_quantity holding the position target) is excluded from the drift statistic rather than mixed in. - test_vst_fidelity_accounting.py covers: - a cancelled zero-fill leg is unfilled, not reject - a venue REJECTED leg is reject - latency over fills only, and unfilled_rest_ms reported - the in-place migration of a pre-existing table with a reject row that becomes unfilled - target_quantity equals the pre-rounding order delta - drift within the step size for an ordinary leg - pre-fix rows excluded from drift It passes under pytest-xdist.
bug.actual: Root cause: fidelity.py treats "no fill" as rejection; vst_fidelity takes latency over all legs; bingx_mirror records the position target where the spec meant the pre-rounding order quantity.
bug.constraints: Placement behaviour is unchanged: no order differs in symbol, side, type, quantity, price or client id No file outside the four listed is edited Do not edit docs/user-journeys/
